notes.title: version 0.910 udpate!
notes.content:
Improved driving control system that include the following features

• ABS
• TCS
• ESC
• Drift Assist (much easier to stabilize vehicle)
• Horn is now available(by key H)
• Vehicle damage with model deformation

and few bug fixes.


In the next version , we will have a new vehicle available !  Bear with me.

notes.title: 0.908 version update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Version 0.908 has been updated to include the following changes and contents:
[List] [*] Added "tactical supply points" in fixed positions,they are visible by default on your map. The site provides advanced weapons and conventional supplies, but is guarded by NPC soldiers equipped with rocket launchers.
You can find advanced props such as rocket launchers, laser designators, satellite signal receivers, etc.
[*] Airdrop supplies remove the provision of advanced weapons and ammunition, providing only basic supplies: turret weapon ammunition and repairing kits.
[*] The firing range of the helicopters have been adjusted to give player reachable turret elevation angle to shoot at.
[*]AI units will be more inclined to shoot players ' bodies than vehicle parts, get your self some basic armor, would you? (-_-!)
[*] The map is turned on by default to zoom in to the maximum viewing range (zoom can still be adjusted with a scroll wheel)
[*] A new weapon: the "laser designator" is used to guide air strikes, and after acquiring an air support chip, the laser designator can be used to strike enemies on the ground, even without a "notebook" terminal.
[*] some bugs fixed.
[/List]

There are still a lot of shortcomings in this EA state game, but I will not stop optimizing and improving it to approach the player's standards and expectations, thank you for the recent comments and suggestions on the game players, I am an independent game developer, your feedback and support is my driving force forward! 

The next version 0.909 is in progress, and in that release, the physical authenticity and gameplay of the vehicle will be further balanced, making it easier for players to drive. The plan is get it online in a week or so, please keep your eyes on here or our discord server ( https://discord.gg/bzkCu46). Have fun and good luck!
